eximir.desc: Read, annotate, and normalize Affymetrix miRNA CEL files using spike-in or quantile normalization.

ExperimentHub provides a central location where curated data from experiments, publications or training courses can be accessed. Each resource has associated metadata, tags and date of modification. The client creates an

ExperimentSubset.desc: Experiment objects such as the SummarizedExperiment or SingleCellExperiment are data containers for one or more matrix-like assays along with the associated row and column data. Often only a subset of the original data is needed for down-stream analysis. For example, filtering out poor quality sampl

extraChIPs.desc: This package builds on existing tools and adds some simple but extremely useful capabilities for working wth ChIP-Seq data. The focus is on detecting differential binding windows/regions. One set of functions focusses on set-operations retaining mcols for GRanges objects, whilst another group of fun

factDesign.desc: This package provides a set of tools for analyzing data from a factorial designed microarray experiment, or any microarray experiment for which a linear model is appropriate. The functions can be used to evaluate tests of contrast of biological interest and perform single outlier detection.

factr.desc: Perform functional annotation of a custom-assembled transcriptome by matching gene metadata, filtering for novel transcripts, predicting coding sequences, and analyzing NMD susceptibility and protein domains.
in: custom_assembled_transcriptome.gtf (custom-assembled transcriptome in gtf format containing gene_id and transcript_id attributes)
reference_transcriptome.gtf (reference transcriptome annotation in gtf/gff3 format)
genome_sequence (bsgenome object, 2bit file, or fasta file containing genomic dna sequence)

faers.desc: Download, preprocess, standardize, de-duplicate, and perform pharmacovigilance signal detection on FAERS (FDA Adverse Event Reporting System) quarterly data. Computes disproportionality statistics including ROR (Reporting Odds Ratio) and PRR (Proportional Reporting Ratio) to identify significant adv

famagg.desc: Import pedigree data, manipulate relationships, prune pedigrees, and visualize them as standard pedigree plots or graphs.
in: pedigree_data.txt (a tab-delimited text file containing pedigree columns: family, id, father, mother, sex)

famat.desc: Perform integrated pathway enrichment, interaction network analysis, and GO enrichment on gene and metabolite lists, and visualize the results in a Shiny app.

fastLiquidAssociation.desc: This package extends the function of the LiquidAssociation package for genome-wide application. It integrates a screening method into the LA analysis to reduce the number of triplets to be examined for a high LA value and provides code for use in subsequent significance analyses.

fastqcleaner.desc: Filter, trim, and clean FASTQ reads using a sequence of quality, length, adapter, and complexity filters.
in: example_fastq.gz (fastq file containing raw sequencing reads)

fastseg.desc: Segment genomic data represented as a GRanges object to identify copy number segments and plot the results.
in: gr (granges object containing genomic coordinates and sample intensity/log-ratio data in metadata columns)

fccac.desc: Evaluate covariance and reproducibility across multiple NGS datasets using functional canonical correlation analysis and visualize the results as a heatmap.
in: peakfile.bed (bed file containing genomic regions of interest)
bigwig1.bw, bigwig2.bw, bigwig3.bw (bigwig files of mapped reads for each dataset/replicate)

fci.desc: Identify differentially expressed genes from a single-omic dataset (e.g., transcriptomics or proteomics) with control and case replicates.
in: supp_dataset_part_2.txt (tab-delimited file with genes in rows and sample expression values in columns)

feast.desc: Perform consensus clustering, calculate gene-level F-statistics, evaluate multiple top feature subsets using TSCAN or SC3, and validate using Mean Squared Error (MSE).
in: y (raw count expression matrix with genes as rows and cells as columns)

featseekr.desc: Select and rank a subset of highly reproducible, non-redundant features from high-dimensional replicated data.
in: summarizedexperiment object containing replicated measurements across conditions (features x samples).

fedup.desc: Test one or more gene sets against a background for pathway enrichment and depletion using Fisher's exact test, visualize with a dot plot, and generate an enrichment map in Cytoscape.
in: gene_list.rds (a named list containing a 'background' character vector and one or more test set character vectors)

fella.desc: Build a local KEGG database for a specific organism, map a list of affected metabolites, perform network-based enrichment (diffusion or PageRank), and export/visualize the resulting subnetwork.
in: list_of_compounds.txt (a character vector of affected kegg compound ids)

fenr.desc: Perform rapid functional enrichment analysis on a selected set of genes against a background set using fetched Gene Ontology annotations.
in: background_genes.txt (a vector of all detected gene symbols in the experiment)
selected_genes.txt (a vector of gene symbols of interest, such as differentially expressed genes)

ffpe.desc: Identify low-quality data using metrics developed for expression data derived from Formalin-Fixed, Paraffin-Embedded (FFPE) data.  Also a function for making Concordance at the Top plots (CAT-plots).

fgga.desc: Predict hierarchically consistent Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for protein sequences using a factor graph ensemble of SVM classifiers.
in: dxcf (a numeric matrix of characterized sequence features for proteins, such as physico-chemical properties)
tablecfgo (a binary matrix of known protein-to-go-term annotations used for training)
nodesgo (a character vector of target go terms)

fgnet.desc: Perform GO enrichment analysis on a gene list offline and build a functional network.
in: genesyeastexpr (optional named numeric vector of gene expression values)

fgsea.desc: Run fast preranked gene set enrichment analysis on a ranked list of genes.
in: naive.vs.th1.rnk (tab-separated file containing gene ids and ranking statistics)

filterffpe.desc: Find and filter artificial chimeric reads and their duplicates from an FFPE BAM file to prepare it for downstream structural variation calling.
in: file.bam (indexed bam file of the ffpe sample with pcr/optical duplicates marked or removed)

findips.desc: Detect influential points affecting feature rankings for binary or continuous outcomes using t-test, Kruskal-Wallis, or custom ranking functions.
in: expression_matrix.csv (high-dimensional feature matrix with samples as rows and genes as columns)
phenotype_labels.csv (binary or continuous response vector matching the samples)

FindIT2.desc: This package implements functions to find influential TF and target based on different input type. It have five module: Multi-peak multi-gene annotaion(mmPeakAnno module), Calculate regulation potential(calcRP module), Find influential Target based on ChIP-Seq and RNA-Seq data(Find influential Targe

fishalyser.desc: Manually compute probe/cell masks and clean up artifacts using thresholding and particle analysis to determine optimal size parameters.

fishpond.desc: Perform differential transcript or gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq data using inferential replicates.
in: salmon quantification directories (containing quant.sf or quant.sf.gz files with gibbs or bootstrap replicates)

fithic.desc: Run Fit-Hi-C on raw Hi-C contact maps without normalization bias files to estimate interaction significance.
in: intersfile.gz (raw contact counts between fragment pairs)

flagme.desc: Read raw GC-MS data, import peak deconvolution results, perform multiple alignment across experimental groups, and extract the aligned peak table.

flowbeads.desc: Load bead data, gate bead populations, compute absolute MEF transformation parameters, and apply the transform to sample flow cytometry data.
in: beads1.fcs (fcs file containing bead run data)
dakomef.csv (csv file containing manufacturer mef values)
flow.data (flowframe containing the actual sample flow cytometry data to be normalized)

flowbin.desc: Integrate multitube flow cytometry data with shared markers into a single expression matrix using quantile normalization and binning.
in: fs1 (flowset object containing flowframes for each tube)

flowcatchr.desc: Track flowing blood cells in time-lapse microscopy images and analyze their kinematic properties.
in: image.files (a folder containing tiff/jpg/png time-lapse microscopy images or a vector of image file paths)

flowchic.desc: Perform cytometric histogram image comparison (CHIC) on FCS files to analyze microbial community dynamics using image overlap/XOR calculations and NMDS visualization.
in: abiotic_incol (optional data frame of abiotic parameters)

flowclean.desc: Perform quality control on a flow cytometry dataset to identify and filter out cells collected during perturbed time periods.
in: user_data.fcs (flow cytometry data file containing marker intensities and collection time)

flowclust.desc: Perform robust model-based clustering on flow cytometry data, select the best model using BIC, adjust outlier identification rules, and visualize the results.
in: rituximab (flowframe object containing flow cytometry data)

flowcore.desc: Read FCS files, calculate and apply spectral compensation, transform fluorescence channels, and apply manual gates to filter populations.
in: fcs.dir (directory containing single-stained compensation control fcs files)
comp_match.csv (csv file matching control filenames to channels)

flowCut.desc: Common techinical complications such as clogging can result in spurious events and fluorescence intensity shifting, flowCut is designed to detect and remove technical artifacts from your data by removing segments that show statistical differences from other segments.

flowcybar.desc: Normalize cytometric cell abundance data and visualize community dynamics using barcodes and boxplots.
in: cell_number_sample.txt (tab-separated text file containing sample names in the first column and cell numbers or percentages per gate in subsequent columns)

flowfp.desc: Create a probability binning model from flow cytometry data, generate fingerprints, and combine them into a plex for multi-model or multi-resolution analysis.
in: fs1 (flowset containing raw flow cytometry list-mode data)
fs2 (flowset containing raw flow cytometry list-mode data for comparison)

flowgate.desc: Import FCS files, convert to a GatingSet, apply compensation, interactively draw manual gates (polygon, span, quadrant), and export plots and statistics.

flowgraph.desc: Perform standard differential cell population analysis on flow cytometry cell count data using SpecEnr.
in: count (sample x cell population numeric matrix of cell counts)
meta (data frame with sample metadata, containing an 'id' column matching row names of count)

flowmatch.desc: Match cell populations (clusters) across a pair of flow cytometry samples using the Mixed Edge Cover (MEC) algorithm.

flowmeans.desc: Identify and visualize cell populations in flow cytometry data using non-parametric clustering and change point detection.
in: flow_data.csv (matrix or data frame of flow cytometry measurements with marker channels)

flowmerge.desc: Perform automated gating of flow cytometry data by fitting mixture models, merging redundant components, and selecting the optimal population representation.
in: sample.fcs (flow cytometry data file containing cell marker measurements, represented as a flowframe)

flowpeaks.desc: Cluster a numeric matrix of flow cytometry data, visualize the results in 2D/pairwise plots, evaluate cluster performance against a gold standard, and identify outliers.
in: barcode (a numeric matrix or data frame representing flow cytometry measurements)
barcode.cid (a vector of gold standard cluster ids for evaluation)

flowPloidy.desc: Determine sample ploidy via flow cytometry histogram analysis. Reads Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) files via the flowCore bioconductor package, and provides functions for determining the DNA ploidy of samples based on internal standards.

flowplots.desc: Compute profile, marginal, PFD, and PFD parts summary datasets from stacked ICS flow cytometry data using the StackedData class.
in: stacked_data.csv (gated ics flow cytometry data in stacked format with columns for id, group, subsetting variables, percent/count, and cytokine combinations)

FlowSOM.desc: FlowSOM offers visualization options for cytometry data, by using Self-Organizing Map clustering and Minimal Spanning Trees.

flowSpecs.desc: This package is intended to fill the role of conventional cytometry pre-processing software, for spectral decomposition, transformation, visualization and cleanup, and to aid further downstream analyses, such as with DepecheR, by enabling transformation of flowFrames and flowSets to dataframes. Func

flowstats.desc: Perform automated gating and landmark-based normalization on a GatingSet of flow cytometry data.
in: itn (flowset or gatingset containing flow cytometry samples with fsc, ssc, and fluorescence channels)

flowtime.desc: Analyze single time-point flow cytometry data by annotating, gating, and compiling individual events.

flowtrans.desc: Optimize transformation parameters for flow cytometry channels to achieve multivariate normality and transform the data.
in: flowframe.rds (a flowframe object containing flow cytometry measurements)

flowviz.desc: Visualize flow cytometry data in 2D scatter plots with geometric or data-driven gates.
in: gvhd (flowset object containing flow cytometry data)

flowVS.desc: Per-channel variance stabilization from a collection of flow cytometry samples by Bertlett test for homogeneity of variances. The approach is applicable to microarrays data as well.

fmcsr.desc: Compute, extract, and visualize the exact or mismatch-tolerant maximum common substructure between two compounds.

fmrs.desc: Fit a finite mixture of regression/AFT model, select optimal tuning parameters, and perform sparse variable selection.

fraser.desc: Detect rare aberrant splicing events starting from raw RNA-seq BAM files.
in: sampletable.tsv (sample annotation table containing sampleid, bamfile, and other covariates)

frenchfish.desc: Correct automatically counted FISH spots from FISHalyseR CSV output using a homogenous Poisson Point Process model and nuclear volume correction.
in: samplefish.jpg_data.csv (fishalyser csv output containing spot counts and nuclear area)

frgepistasis.desc: Detect epistasis between genomic regions using the Functional Regression Model (FRG).
in: simgeno-chr*.raw (genotype files in plink recodea format)

frma.desc: Preprocessing and analysis for single microarrays and microarray batches.

frmaTools.desc: Tools for advanced use of the frma package.

funOmics.desc: The 'funOmics' package ggregates or summarizes omics data into higher level functional representations such as GO terms gene sets or KEGG metabolic pathways. The aggregated data matrix represents functional activity scores that facilitate the analysis of functional molecular sets while allowing to r

fusesom.desc: Run FuseSOM clustering, estimate the optimal number of clusters, and visualize results using a standard matrix or data frame.
in: risom_dat (data.frame or matrix of normalized expression data where columns are markers and rows are cell observations)

GA4GHclient.desc: GA4GHclient provides an easy way to access public data servers through Global Alliance for Genomics and Health (GA4GH) genomics API. It provides low-level access to GA4GH API and translates response data into Bioconductor-based class objects.

GA4GHshiny.desc: GA4GHshiny package provides an easy way to interact with data servers based on Global Alliance for Genomics and Health (GA4GH) genomics API through a Shiny application. It also integrates with Beacon Network.

gaga.desc: Fit the GaGa model to expression data, identify differentially expressed genes under a target FDR, and estimate posterior fold changes.
in: expression_matrix.csv (normalized gene expression matrix where rows are genes and columns are samples)
sample_groups.csv (metadata containing group labels for each sample)

gage.desc: GAGE is a published method for gene set (enrichment or GSEA) or pathway analysis. GAGE is generally applicable independent of microarray or RNA-Seq data attributes including sample sizes, experimental designs, assay platforms, and other types of heterogeneity, and consistently achieves superior perf

gaprediction.desc: Predict gestational age from blood DNA methylation data.
in: mlmatr (a data frame or matrix of illumina humanmethylation450 cpg beta values between 0 and 1, with samples as rows and cpgs as columns)

gars.desc: Run the genetic algorithm to select a robust subset of features from normalized high-dimensional data and visualize the results.
in: datanorm (normalized summarizedexperiment, matrix, or data.frame of expression data)

gatefinder.desc: Identify and visualize an optimal sequence of 2D polygon gates to isolate a target cell population from high-dimensional cytometry data.
in: targetpop (logical vector indicating target cell population membership)

gatom.desc: Identify an active metabolic module from paired transcriptomics and metabolomics differential expression data using atom-level topology.
in: gene.de.rawex (differential gene expression table with columns id, pval, log2fc, basemean)
met.de.rawex (differential metabolite abundance table with columns id, pval, log2fc, basemean)

gbscleanr.desc: Convert raw VCF genotype data to GDS, perform quality control and filtering, define the breeding scheme, estimate true genotypes using HMM, and export the corrected genotypes.

gcapc.desc: Perform GC-bias-corrected peak calling and refine peak significance from a ChIP-seq BAM file.

gcatest.desc: Perform genotype conditional association testing on genome-wide SNP data and a trait while controlling for population structure.
in: plink binary genotype files (.bed) or genotype matrix

gcrisprtools.desc: Preprocess, normalize, analyze, and visualize a single pooled CRISPR/shRNA screen to identify candidate target genes.
in: ann (annotation data.frame mapping cassettes to geneid/genesymbol)
essential.genes (character vector of known essential genes for validation)

gdnax.desc: Diagnose genomic DNA contamination in RNA-seq BAM files and filter out reads of potential gDNA origin.
in: bamfiles (character vector of paths to bam files)
txdb (txdb annotation object or package name)

gdr.desc: Manually aggregate, normalize, average, and fit drug response data step-by-step to maintain granular control over intermediate SummarizedExperiment objects.

gDRimport.desc: The package is a part of the gDR suite. It helps to prepare raw drug response data for downstream processing. It mainly contains helper functions for importing/loading/validating dose-response data provided in different file formats.

gDRutils.desc: This package contains utility functions used throughout the gDR platform to fit data, manipulate data, and convert and validate data structures. This package also has the necessary default constants for gDR platform. Many of the functions are utilized by the gDRcore package.

GDSArray.desc: GDS files are widely used to represent genotyping or sequence data. The GDSArray package implements the `GDSArray` class to represent nodes in GDS files in a matrix-like representation that allows easy manipulation (e.g., subsetting, mathematical transformation) in _R_. The data remains on disk unti

gdsfmt.desc: Provides a high-level R interface to CoreArray Genomic Data Structure (GDS) data files. GDS is portable across platforms with hierarchical structure to store multiple scalable array-oriented data sets with metadata information. It is suited for large-scale datasets, especially for data which are muc

GeDi.desc: The package provides different distances measurements to calculate the difference between genesets. Based on these scores the genesets are clustered and visualized as graph. This is all presented in an interactive Shiny application for easy usage.

gemini.desc: GEMINI uses log-fold changes to model sample-dependent and independent effects, and uses a variational Bayes approach to infer these effects. The inferred effects are used to score and identify genetic interactions, such as lethality and recovery. More details can be found in Zamanighomi et al. 2019

gemma_r.desc: Low- and high-level wrappers for Gemma's RESTful API. They enable access to curated expression and d

genarise.desc: Preprocess raw dual-color microarray data, perform background correction, normalize, filter low-quality spots, resolve replicates, and identify differentially expressed genes using Z-scores.
in: raw_intensities.txt (tab-delimited file containing cy3/cy5 intensities, backgrounds, and gene ids)

genebreak.desc: Detect and analyze recurrent gene breakpoints starting from a preprocessed cghCall or QDNAseq Bioconductor object.
in: copynumber.data.chr20 (cghcall object containing segmented and called copy number data)
ens.gene.ann.hg18 (data.frame containing gene annotations with columns gene, chromosome, start, end)

geneclassifiers.desc: Apply published gene expression classifiers to pre-normalized ExpressionSet data to obtain patient risk scores and classifications, with optional handling of missing probe-sets.
in: expression_set.rdata (expressionset object containing pre-normalized gene expression data)

GeneExpressionSignature.desc: This package gives the implementations of the gene expression signature and its distance to each. Gene expression signature is represented as a list of genes whose expression is correlated with a biological state of interest. And its distance is defined using a nonparametric, rank-based pattern-matc

genefilter.desc: Filter genes from an expression dataset using non-specific criteria, specific criteria, or a combination of both.
in: sample.expressionset (expressionset containing expression data and sample covariates)

genega.desc: Optimize a gene sequence considering both codon usage bias and mRNA secondary structure using a genetic algorithm.
in: egfp.fasta (fasta file containing the gene sequence to optimize)

genegeneinter.desc: Test for statistical interaction between two genes represented by sets of SNPs in a case-control study.
in: gene1_snps.csv (genotype matrix for snps in gene 1)
gene2_snps.csv (genotype matrix for snps in gene 2)

genemeta.desc: Perform step-by-step meta-analysis of two-sample microarray data to calculate effect sizes, evaluate heterogeneity, and fit fixed or random effects models.

GeneNetworkBuilder.desc: Appliation for discovering direct or indirect targets of transcription factors using ChIP-chip or ChIP-seq, and microarray or RNA-seq gene expression data. Inputting a list of genes of potential targets of one TF from ChIP-chip or ChIP-seq, and the gene expression results, GeneNetworkBuilder generat

geneoverlap.desc: Test the statistical significance of the overlap between two individual gene lists and retrieve detailed association statistics.
in: list1.txt (character vector of gene ids for list a)
list2.txt (character vector of gene ids for list b)
background_size (integer representing the total number of genes in the genomic background)

geneplast.desc: Calculate the diversity, abundance, and evolutionary plasticity index (EPI) of orthologous groups.
in: cogdata (data frame mapping genes to orthologous groups and species)

geneplotter.desc: Visualize expression levels across all chromosomes using a reference genome

generecommender.desc: Identify and rank genes coexpressed with a query set of genes in microarray data, with options for cross-validation and custom scoring.
in: genedata (microarray expression matrix with genes as rows and experiments as columns)
my.query (character vector of query gene/probeset ids)

generegionscan.desc: Extract probe-level intensities from raw CEL files for a specific genomic region and build a ProbeLevelSet object.

generxcluster.desc: Detect and analyze genomic regions with differential clustering of integration sites between two groups.
in: exptdata.txt (a tab-delimited text file containing columns for chromosome, position, and group indicator)

geneselectmmd.desc: Select differentially expressed genes, estimate error rates, and plot model fit from an ExpressionSet object.
in: eset1 (expressionset object containing gene expression data and phenotypic metadata)

genestructuretools.desc: Import, filter, and analyze Whippet alternative splicing events, generate in silico alternative isoforms, and annotate/compare their open reading frames (ORFs).

genetclassifier.desc: Train a multi-class SVM classifier, rank significant genes, estimate generalization error, and construct co-expression networks from gene expression data.
in: expression_data.rdata (expressionset containing normalized raw-scale gene expression values)
sample_metadata.csv (metadata containing class labels for each sample)

geneticsped.desc: Set up and solve mixed model equations for an animal model using pedigree data and phenotypes.
in: pedigree_data.csv (data frame containing individual, sire, dam, sex, and phenotype columns)

genetonic.desc: Integrate expression data, differential expression results, and functional enrichment results to perform interactive exploration and generate a reproducible HTML report.
in: org.hs.eg.db (annotation database for mapping ensembl ids to gene symbols)
topgode_macrophage_ifng_vs_naive (or raw enrichment results from topgo/clusterprofiler)

genie3.desc: Infer a gene regulatory network from a gene expression matrix using default or customized tree-based parameters and extract ranked regulatory links.
in: exprmatr (matrix of gene expression data where rows are genes and columns are samples)

genocn.desc: Identify germline copy number variations (CNVs) and genotype calls from SNP array data.
in: snp_data.txt (tab-delimited file containing chromosome, position, lrr, and baf values for each probe)
cnv_parameter.txt (text file containing initial parameter specifications for the cnv hmm)

genomation.desc: Extract genomic signal (e.g., CAGE, ChIP-seq) over windows of interest (e.g., promoters, exons) and visualize via heatmaps or meta-plots.

genomautomorphism.desc: Compute and analyze genomic automorphisms on 1D cyclic groups (Z64 or Z125) from pairwise aligned DNA sequences to identify mutational events, indels, and estimate mutation type probabilities.
in: covid_aln (pairwise aligned dna sequences of protein-coding regions, loaded as a dnamultiplealignment object)

genomeIntervals.desc: This package defines classes for representing genomic intervals and provides functions and methods for working with these. Note: The package provides the basic infrastructure for and is enhanced by the package 'girafe'.

genomes.desc: Download genome and assembly reports from NCBI

genomicalignments.desc: Count aligned reads overlapping genomic features to prepare a count matrix for downstream differential expression analysis.
in: features (genomic features as a granges or grangeslist object)

GenomicDataCommons.desc: Programmatically access the NIH / NCI Genomic Data Commons RESTful service.

genomicdistributions.desc: Characterize and visualize basic properties of genomic ranges including chromosome distribution, distance to TSS/features, genomic partitions, neighbor distances, widths, and sequence content.
in: vistaenhancers.bed.gz (bed file of genomic ranges of interest)
setb_100.bed.gz (additional bed file of genomic ranges for comparison)

GenomicFeatures.desc: Extract the genomic locations of genes, transcripts, exons, introns, and CDS, for the gene models stored in a TxDb object. A TxDb object is a small database that contains the gene models of a given organism/assembly. Bioconductor provides a small collection of TxDb objects in the form of ready-to-in

GenomicFiles.desc: This package provides infrastructure for parallel computations distributed 'by file' or 'by range'. User defined MAPPER and REDUCER functions provide added flexibility for data combination and manipulation.

genomicinstability.desc: Estimate genomic instability scores and neoplastic likelihood for single cells without a prior normal reference.
in: tpm_matrix (a matrix of transcripts-per-million (tpm) or gene expression values where rows are genes and columns are cells)

genomicinteractionnodes.desc: Import chromatin interactions, detect interaction nodes, annotate them with gene promoters, and perform Gene Ontology enrichment analysis.
in: wt.2.bedpe (chromatin interaction loops in bedpe format)

GenomicInteractions.desc: Utilities for handling genomic interaction data such as ChIA-PET or Hi-C, annotating genomic features with interaction information, and producing plots and summary statistics.

GenomicOZone.desc: The package clusters gene activity along chromosome into zones, detects differential zones as outstanding, and visualizes maps of outstanding zones across the genome. It enables characterization of effects on multiple genes within adaptive genomic neighborhoods, which could arise from genome reorgan

GenomicPlot.desc: Visualization of next generation sequencing (NGS) data is essential for interpreting high-throughput genomics experiment results. 'GenomicPlot' facilitates plotting of NGS data in various formats (bam, bed, wig and bigwig); both coverage and enrichment over input can be computed and displayed with r

GenomicRanges.desc: The ability to efficiently represent and manipulate genomic annotations and alignments is playing a central role when it comes to analyzing high-throughput sequencing data (a.k.a. NGS data). The GenomicRanges package defines general purpose containers for storing and manipulating genomic intervals a

GenomicScores.desc: Provide infrastructure to store and access genomewide position-specific scores within R and Bioconductor.

genomicsupersignature.desc: Validate a user's transcriptomic dataset against a pre-built RAVmodel to identify and biologically interpret the most relevant Replicable Axes of Variation (RAVs).
in: dataset.rds (expressionset, summarizedexperiment, or matrix containing gene expression data with gene symbols)

GenomicTuples.desc: GenomicTuples defines general purpose containers for storing genomic tuples. It aims to provide functionality for tuples of genomic co-ordinates that are analogous to those available for genomic ranges in the GenomicRanges Bioconductor package.

genvisr.desc: Visualize somatic mutations, mutation burden, and clinical data at the cohort level using a waterfall plot.
in: brcamaf (a data frame representing a maf file)
clinical (a data frame of clinical data in long format)

geodiff.desc: Perform background modeling, probe aggregation, target/sample QC, Poisson threshold normalization, and differential expression analysis on NanoString GeoMx DSP RNA data.
in: kidney (nanostringgeomxset object containing probe-level expression data, negative probes, and sample/feature metadata)

GEOexplorer.desc: GEOexplorer is a webserver and R/Bioconductor package and web application that enables users to perform gene expression analysis. The development of GEOexplorer was made possible because of the excellent code provided by GEO2R (https: //www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/geo2r/).

GEOfastq.desc: GEOfastq is used to download fastq files from the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) starting with an accession from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). To do this, sample metadata is retrieved from GEO and the Sequence Read Archive (SRA). SRA run accessions are then used to construct FTP and aspera d

geometrid.desc: Generate 3D coordinates from a genomic interaction matrix, add gene annotations and genomic signals, and render the interactive 3D plot.

geomxtools.desc: Read, QC, aggregate, normalize, and coerce GeoMx RNA data to Seurat or SpatialExperiment objects.

GEOquery.desc: The NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) is a public repository of microarray data.  Given the rich and varied nature of this resource, it is only natural to want to apply BioConductor tools to these data.  GEOquery is the bridge between GEO and BioConductor.

GEOsubmission.desc: Data submission and upload preparation tool for depositing processed study data and sample metadata for public archival. Creates a formatted single-file package for direct deposit to data repositories. This is a deposit utility only — it does NOT download, retrieve, or analyze existing datasets. For

geotcgadata.desc: Perform differential expression analysis on RNA-seq count data using a Wilcoxon test or other methods.
in: df (matrix or data frame of raw rna-seq counts)

gep2pep.desc: Create a local pathway repository and convert ranked gene expression profiles (GEPs) into Pathway Expression Profiles (PEPs).
in: geps_matrix (matrix of ranked gene expression profiles where rows are genes, columns are conditions, and values are ranks)

getDEE2.desc: Digital Expression Explorer 2 (or DEE2 for short) is a repository of processed RNA-seq data in the form of counts. It was designed so that researchers could undertake re-analysis and meta-analysis of published RNA-seq studies quickly and easily. As of April 2020, over 1 million SRA datasets have bee

geva.desc: Perform a detailed, step-by-step Gene Expression Variation Analysis (GEVA) from input files to final gene classification, allowing fine-tuning of each intermediate step.
in: cond_a_2h.txt (de results for condition a at 2h)
cond_b_2h.txt (de results for condition b at 2h)
cond_c_2h.txt (de results for condition c at 2h)
cond_a_4h.txt (de results for condition a at 4h)
cond_b_4h.txt (de results for condition b at 4h)
cond_c_4h.txt (de results for condition c at 4h)

gewist.desc: Prioritize SNPs and perform interaction testing when the interaction effect size (theta_gc) is known or estimated.
in: genoset (genotype matrix of m snps for n individuals)
trait (quantitative phenotype vector of length n)
cov (covariate measurements vector of length n)
snpset (data frame containing snp names and maf values)
theta_gc (estimated variance explained by gxe interaction)

gg4way.desc: Compare two contrasts from a limma-voom analysis using a 4-way plot and extract shared significant genes.
in: efit (an marraylm object from limma containing differential expression results for multiple contrasts)

ggbio.desc: Build and navigate a multi-track genomic visualization containing an ideogram, gene models, alignment coverage/mismatches, and variants.

ggcyto.desc: With the dedicated fortify method implemented for flowSet, ncdfFlowSet and GatingSet classes, both raw and gated flow cytometry data can be plotted directly with ggplot. ggcyto wrapper and some customed layers also make it easy to add gates and population statistics to the plot.
